issues.description: The problem statement's UML diagram names the class 'Course' while the exercise text and both the template and solution use the class name 'Lecture'. This mismatch in the UML (class name) can confuse students about which class to implement and whether they should use 'Course' or 'Lecture'.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the UML diagram's class from 'Course' to 'Lecture' in problem_statement.md so it matches the textual description, the template, and the solution. Alternatively, if 'Course' was intended, update the template and solution to use 'Course' consistently. Ensure the UML and textual references use the same class name to avoid confusion.
